crossRefs.note: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome…
For Yahweh had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb…
except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed Yahweh…
These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
Then the children of Judah came near to Joshua in Gilgal. Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You…
Caleb said, “I will give Achsah my daughter as wife to the man who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it.”
But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land…
crossRefs.keyword: wholly followed. Heb. fulfilled to go after

people.name: Caleb
people.line: Faithful spy, given Hebron as inheritance

people.name: Jephunneh
people.line: The Kenizzite, father of Caleb the spy.

translations.web: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. He shall see it. I will give the land that he has trodden on to him and to his children, because he has wholly followed Yahweh.”
translations.bsb: except Caleb son of Jephunneh. He will see it, and I will give him and his descendants the land on which he has set foot, because he followed the LORD wholeheartedly.”
translations.kjv: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the LORD.
translations.asv: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh: he shall see it; and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed Jehovah.
